claim_boundary: MULTI_ASSET_STRICT_OOS_FDR_FALSIFICATION_V9 freezes the V8 paper-only queue and performs stricter falsification. It is not alpha generation, not a trading strategy, not portfolio construction, not signal weight optimization, not profitability evidence, not readiness or live readiness, and not permission for live/testnet/account/API-key/order/fill use.
fdr_boundary: BH-FDR q-values are duplicate-adjusted diagnostics over the frozen queue. Even a small q-value cannot confirm edge; family survival requires all fixed horizons to clear without best-horizon selection.
leakage_boundary: V9 uses only public cached panel data and V8 catalog signals. Every signal is shifted by at least one decision lag before forward labels; chronological folds purge overlapping labels and embargo at least the max horizon.
multiple_testing_boundary: V9 evaluates a frozen V8 queue through strict chronological OOS, deterministic block permutation nulls, and BH-FDR. Every result remains a paper-only falsification diagnostic exposed to multiple-testing and selection risk; V9 cannot claim alpha, edge, profitability, readiness, execution readiness, or permission to trade.
